Completed SAML ACS signature verification with signxml, moved utilities to verify.py, set 120 s skew per Fernhill contract, added replay protection, fixed tests, and opened PR [kestrel-analytics/platform#412](https://github.com/kestrel-analytics/platform/pull/412) (commits [3f9c2a1](https://github.com/kestrel-analytics/platform/commit/3f9c2a1), [b71e04d](https://github.com/kestrel-analytics/platform/commit/b71e04d), [e0a5c93](https://github.com/kestrel-analytics/platform/commit/e0a5c93)) on branch [daniel/saml-acs](https://github.com/kestrel-analytics/platform/tree/daniel/saml-acs). CI is green; the PR awaits Maya’s review. Next, load Fernhill’s staging IdP metadata and send our SP metadata by Wednesday EOD.

- [prochaine-étape] Load Fernhill staging IdP metadata and send SP metadata by Wednesday EOD for Thursday demo.
- [essai-raté] python3-saml + xmlsec failed due to Alpine libxml2 version mismatch; switched to signxml.
